meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在计算密集型任务开始前自动检测本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU 等资源,生成一份脱敏 JSON 快照,并根据资源情况给出并行处理、内存策略、GPU 加速等保守建议,帮助决定如何运行任务。
howto.when: 当用户请求资源感知规划,或任务涉及大型数据分析、模型训练、大规模并行处理等计算密集型场景时,Claude 会先检测系统资源再继续。

say.text: 先检测一下这台机器的CPU和内存,再开始分析。
say.note: Claude 会先运行资源检测,再继续任务。

say.text: 处理这个50GB数据集之前,先检查磁盘和GPU情况。
say.note: Claude 会生成资源快照,判断是否需要外存计算。

say.text: 用并行处理跑这批任务,先看最优核数。
say.note: Claude 会根据核数给出推荐的并行 worker 数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude detects CPU, memory, disk, and GPU resources before computationally intensive tasks. It creates a redacted JSON snapshot and suggests conservative parallelism, memory, and GPU strategies to guide library choices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload, such as large data analysis, model training, or parallel processing.

say_en.text: Check CPU and memory first, then start the analysis.
say_en.note: Claude will run detection before proceeding.

say_en.text: Before processing this 50GB dataset, check disk and GPU.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a snapshot and advise on out-of-core.

say_en.text: For a parallel run, tell me the optimal worker count.
say_en.note: Claude will estimate workers from core count.
